content.user_title: Benchmark Your Pay Against Company and Market Medians
content.value_statement: Base salary alone does not show how your compensation compares with peers. This skill compares annual total pay with company level medians and market data.
actual_capabilities: Combine base salary, annual vesting stock, and received bonuses into annual total compensation.
Extract compensation figures from user-shared documents and list them for correction.
Resolve company, job family, and location names using Levels.fyi lookup tools.
Compare total pay with company medians for the current and next levels.
Explain raise outcomes and build recruiter expectation ranges from level medians.
Provide a market median reference while noting that it covers all levels.
limitations: Requires access to external Levels.fyi tools and related skills; this file does not implement them.
Stock option valuation is excluded from compensation totals.
Free data does not show equity refresher norms, and market medians cover all levels.
Results depend on supplied figures and available data; they are not financial advice.

use_cases.title: Assess a merit increase
use_cases.description: Compare new annual compensation with the company median and explain how much a raise changed the gap.

use_cases.title: Prepare for a promotion discussion
use_cases.description: Identify the next company level and compare its median compensation with current total pay.

use_cases.title: Set recruiter expectations
use_cases.description: Build a total compensation range from current and next level medians for the relevant role and location.

prompt_templates.title: Start a pay comparison
prompt_templates.prompt: Benchmark my current pay against my company level median. Ask me for missing details one or two questions at a time.

prompt_templates.title: Review a raise letter
prompt_templates.prompt: Read my attached raise letter, list the figures for correction, and compare my new annual pay with the company median.

prompt_templates.title: Measure a promotion gap
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare my current total compensation with company medians at my level and the next level. Separate the broader market reference.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a recruiter range
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my company, role, level, location, and annual pay details to build a recruiter compensation range. Cite medians and explain coverage limits.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: form an evidence-based expectation range

output_examples.input: Illustrative supplied figures: annual base $140,000, annual vesting stock $30,000, bonus $10,000; matching company level median $200,000.
output: Your annual total pay is $180,000, which is $20,000, or 10%, below the supplied company level median.
Total pay includes $140,000 base, $30,000 annual vesting stock, and $10,000 bonus.
This example uses supplied figures, not a live salary lookup.

output_examples.input: Illustrative supplied figures: old total pay $180,000, new total pay $198,000, company level median $200,000, next level median $240,000.
output: Your new annual total pay is $198,000, which is $2,000, or 1%, below the supplied current level median.
The raise adds $18,000, a 10% increase, and reduces the current level gap from $20,000 to $2,000.
The supplied next level median is $240,000, leaving a $42,000 gap from your new pay.

best_practices: Confirm extracted document figures and specify the period and currency for each pay component.
Use stock that vests annually and bonuses actually received, rather than headline grant values.
Match company level, job family, and location before interpreting compensation gaps.
anti_patterns: Compare base salary alone with a total compensation median.
Treat an all-level market median as a direct peer comparison.
Treat estimated stock option values or unavailable refresher norms as verified compensation data.

faq.question: What information do I need?
faq.answer: Provide company, role, level or title, location, base salary, annual vesting stock, and annual bonus. Specify pay periods and currencies.

faq.question: Can I use a compensation document?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill reads figures from a shared document and lists them for correction before comparison.

faq.question: Does it value stock options?
faq.answer: No. It mentions options but excludes their valuation from compensation totals.

faq.question: What happens when local data is missing?
faq.answer: If the location returns no company levels, the skill retries with the country. Broader market medians remain rough references.

faq.question: Does it work without Levels.fyi tools?
faq.answer: It requires Levels.fyi tools for benchmark lookups and refers to the separate levels-fyi skill for access instructions.

faq.question: Will it automatically submit my salary?
faq.answer: No. It offers contribution once and proceeds to a separate contribution skill only after you agree. It stops after refusal.
